gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + past perfect — I wish I had brought.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: I regret telling her the secret.
gaps.explanation: I regret -ing = I shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing (or having + participle for the earlier action).

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ that they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.
